pages.title: Our Inspiration
pages.body: T.S. Mishra University was established in memory of Justice Tribeni Sahai Misra. His commitment to education inspired the founding members to create a centre for learning, knowledge, and wisdom. Born in Mahona, Lucknow, in 1922, he studied at Allahabad University and the University of Lucknow. Read the university’s biography to explore the life and legacy behind its name.

pages.title: Vision & Mission
pages.body: The university’s vision is to use education to develop students’ knowledge, wisdom, and capacity to contribute to society, the economy, and culture. Its mission is to help learners realise their potential and pursue their aspirations. Academic programs and campus activities seek to combine skills with understanding, preparing students to meet change with confidence.

pages.title: Leadership
pages.body: Smt. Kalpna Misra, Chairperson of Vedic and Futuristic Edutech, describes the university’s commitment to empowering young people through education and capacity building. The university’s leadership messages emphasise combining cultural heritage with contemporary knowledge, professional skills, and a commitment to society. Explore the published messages from the Chairperson, Chancellor, and university leadership.

pages.title: Career Counselling Cell
pages.body: T.S. Mishra University Our Career Counseling Cell is your dedicated resource for all things career-related. We understand that choosing a career path can be a daunting task, which is why we're here to provide guidance, support, and resources to help you navigate your journey with confidence. What We Offer Individualized Counselling Our team of experienced career counselors is here to listen, guide, and support you as you explore your interests, strengths, and aspirations. Whether you're undecided about your major or considering a career change, we're here to help you clarify your goals and develop a plan to achieve them. Career Assessments Discover more about yourself and your career preferences through our range of assessments.

pages.title: Training & Placements
pages.body: S Mishra University. Our institution is dedicated to fostering the professional growth and career development of our students. Through a comprehensive array of programs and resources, we aim to equip our students with the skills, knowledge, and opportunities needed to excel in the competitive global marketplace. S Mishra University, we offer a diverse range of training programs designed to enhance both technical expertise and soft skills. These programs are carefully crafted to meet the evolving demands of various industries, ensuring that our students are well-prepared to tackle real-world challenges. From hands-on workshops to industry-specific seminars, our training initiatives are delivered by experienced faculty and industry experts committed to student success.

news.body: T.S. S. Mishra University hosted its grand University Orientation Programme - Deeksharambh 2025.
